# Fixtures provenance

Some fixtures in `legacy/` are derived or copied from the MIT-licensed legacy repositories:

- `node-font2base64` (https://github.com/junminahn/node-font2base64) — Copyright (c) 2023 Junmin Ahn, MIT
  - Original paths sampled: `test/fonts/akronim-v9-latin-regular.{eot,svg,ttf,woff,woff2}`, `test/fonts/akronim-v9-latin-regular.*.base64`, `test/sample/example.css`, `test/sample/example_2.css`
- `base64-injector` (https://github.com/junminahn/base64-injector) — Copyright (c) 2020 Junmin Ahn, MIT
  - Original paths sampled: `fonts/akronim-v9-latin-regular.{eot,svg,ttf}`, `fonts/woff/akronim-v9-latin-regular.{woff,woff2}`, `images/{apple,pear,watermelon}.png`, `example/{akronim-fontface,fruit-background}.css`, `example/example.html` and their `.base64` expectations

What is copied here is **minimal, synthetic reproduction** rather than the full binary font files, to keep the repository lean and to satisfy the task requirement to "Copy only minimal legal fixtures needed to express behavior":

- Font binaries in `legacy/fonts/` are 1–64 byte synthetic placeholders whose bytes are treated as opaque by the legacy encoder (which base64-encodes whatever bytes are present and maps `ext -> mediaType/format` via `fontMap`). Their file names, extensions and byte-equality semantics mirror the originals without redistributing the full upstream font bytes.
- Image files in `legacy/images/` are minimal 1×1 PNG/GIF/JPEG/WebP-like placeholders (valid minimal headers where noted) or short synthetic byte strings for formats that `file-type` cannot reliably detect (SVG, APNG variants). They preserve the extension-driven contract: legacy image mapping is `ext -> mediaType` via `imageMap` (`_base64-injector/image-meta.js:3-50`).
- CSS/HTML samples in `legacy/css/` and `legacy/html/` are hand-typed structural equivalents of the upstream samples (same `url(...)` shapes, same `@font-face` list, same `background`/`img src` patterns) with truncated base64 payloads where the original expected output contained full data URLs. Semantic behavior (which URLs are replaced, preservation of `format(...)` hints, basename vs full-path matching, query/fragment handling) is retained; exact serialization whitespace is **not** treated as a compatibility requirement.

All copied or derived material retains the original MIT notice:

> The MIT License (MIT)
> Copyright (c) Junmin Ahn
> Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions: The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all copies or substantial portions of the Software.

Tracked fixtures are read-only. Tests must use OS temporary directories (`node:os` `tmpdir()` + `node:fs/mkdtempSync`) for any writes and must never modify the source repositories or these tracked files in place.

## Compatibility matrix (ASSET-00)

| Capability                                                                                        | Legacy source                                                                                        | Expected new-contract semantics                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| async encode single file                                                                          | `_base64-font2base64/src/index.ts:159-162` (`encodeToDataUrl`), `_base64-injector/core.js:167-170`   | `encodeAsset(path)` returns `EncodedAsset` with `dataUrl = data:<mediaType>;base64,<payload>`; payload decodes byte-for-byte to source                                                                |
| sync encode single file                                                                           | `encodeToDataUrlSync`, `encodeToDataSrcSync`                                                         | `encodeAssetSync` same semantics, sync I/O only, rejects async detection modes                                                                                                                        |
| one/many inputs (array)                                                                           | `isArray` branch                                                                                     | `encodeAssets` / `encodeAssetsSync` preserve input order                                                                                                                                              |
| font fixtures: .svg .ttf .otf .eot .sfnt .woff .woff2                                             | `fontMap` in `font-meta.js:17-46` and `src/index.ts:33-62`                                           | Built-in definitions resolve case-insensitively; `formatCssUrl` vs `formatFontSource` split (legacy `encodeToDataSrc` ambiguity is not preserved)                                                     |
| image fixtures: .apng .bmp .gif .ico .cur .jpg .jpeg .jfif .pjpeg .pjp .png .svg .tif .tiff .webp | `imageMap` in `image-meta.js:3-50`                                                                   | Same as fonts; `.svg` defaults to `image/svg+xml` (image) unless explicit font kind/metadata selects font semantics                                                                                   |
| CSS font replacement (`@font-face src`)                                                           | `_updateCssAst` (`src/index.ts:192-250`) + `_updateCSSContent` (`core.js:204-315`) with `_font=true` | Pure transform over CSS string: every eligible `url(...)` in `src` replaced with font `url(... ) format(...)` where format exists; remote/data/blob skipped; original content unchanged when no match |
| CSS image replacement (`background`, `background-image` legacy)                                   | `core.js:245-304` (`_image=true`, only those two properties)                                         | New contract: every valid local `url(...)` in any declaration value is eligible (generic CSS inliner); legacy two-property limitation is not preserved                                                |
| HTML image replacement (`<img src>`)                                                              | `_updateHTMLContent` (`core.js:317-361`)                                                             | Minimum: `<img src>`; plus `img[srcset]`, `source[srcset]`, `source[src]`, `link[href]` icon, `video[poster]` per Locked contract; `<img>` without `src` must not throw                               |
| full-path matching                                                                                | `fullpathMatch` flag + `path.resolve(cssRoot,url)`                                                   | Exact normalized absolute path matching is default; optional basename fallback is opt-in and ambiguous duplicates are `AmbiguousAssetError` (legacy picked first winner)                              |
| in-memory string/buffer                                                                           | `fromContent`/`fromBuffer`, `fromCSS`/`fromHTML`                                                     | `inlineCss(content, opts)` and `inlineHtml(content, opts)` are synchronous pure transforms over an already-encoded `AssetCatalog`; no I/O off the content string                                      |
| directory discovery                                                                               | `readAllFilesAsync/Sync` (`helpers.ts:83-118`)                                                       | Lexical deterministic order, dedup, depth/count/concurrency bounds, symlink `false` default, cycle detection                                                                                          |
| dry-run / write file processing                                                                   | `resave` flag, `injectBase64(sources,targets)`                                                       | `inlineFiles({write:false})` default does no writes; `write:true` is opt-in atomic rename; unchanged files never rewritten; per-target `InlineFileResult` ordering follows discovery order            |
| negative: unsupported content                                                                     | (missing in suites)                                                                                  | Typed `UnsupportedAssetError` / diagnostic, not silent skip                                                                                                                                           |
| negative: duplicate basenames                                                                     | basename collision (`core.js:219-230`)                                                               | Controlled ambiguity error instead of nondeterministic first-match                                                                                                                                    |
| negative: missing paths                                                                           | silently swallowed (`helpers.ts:95-96`)                                                              | `AssetNotFound` / filesystem diagnostics surfaced                                                                                                                                                     |
| negative: uppercase extensions                                                                    | `extname` case-sensitive                                                                             | Normalized lower-case lookup                                                                                                                                                                          |
| negative: existing data URLs                                                                      | not explicitly filtered                                                                              | Skipped (never re-inlined)                                                                                                                                                                            |
| negative: query/fragment refs                                                                     | `_extractSrcUrl` captures `?#` via `(\\??#.+?)?`                                                     | Query/fragment stripped for filesystem lookup but not emitted in output data URL                                                                                                                      |
| negative: malformed CSS/HTML                                                                      | `css.parse` / `cheerio.load` may throw or coerce                                                     | Documented throw-or-diagnostic policy; no swallowed `console.error` + `true`                                                                                                                          |
| negative: `<img>` without `src`                                                                   | `src.length` deref (`core.js:329` can throw)                                                         | No throw; unchanged                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| negative: SVG image vs explicit SVG-font                                                          | spread ordering `...imageMap,...fontMap` (`core.js:31`) makes font win globally                      | `.svg` → image by default; font available only through explicit `kind:'font'` / `fontFormat` metadata, no global mutation                                                                             |

When legacy prose and tested behavior disagree, the new contract chooses the safer, more explicit semantics and documents the discrepancy here and in `legacy-contract.test.ts`.

## Negative fixtures included

- `negative/unsupported.bin` and `negative/unsupported.txt` — extension not in registry
- `negative/duplicate-a/dup.png` + `negative/duplicate-b/dup.png` — same basename, different directories
- `negative/uppercase/PHOTO.PNG` — uppercase extension
- `negative/data-url.css` — already contains `data:` URL
- `negative/query-fragment.css` — `url('fonts/akronim-v9-latin-regular.woff?#iefix')` shape
- `negative/malformed.css` — unclosed `url(` and broken `@font-face`
- `negative/malformed.html` — unclosed `<img` and stray `srcset`
- `negative/img-no-src.html` — `<img alt="no src">`
- `negative/svg-image.svg` vs `negative/svg-font.svg` — same extension, different intended kind
